name: Krishi Samruddhi Yojana
benefits: ₹5,000 crore / year for 5 years via DBT: infra, micro‑irrigation, organic & climate‑resilient farming, value‑chain support.
documents: Aadhaar; 7/12 land record; bank a/c; AgriStack Farmer ID.

name: Mukhyamantri Saur Krushi Pump Yojana
benefits: Up to ~95% subsidy for off‑grid solar irrigation pumps; daytime power.
documents: Aadhaar; 7/12; water‑source proof; caste cert/NOC if applicable.

name: PM‑KUSUM (Solar)
benefits: Up to ~90% support (60% subsidy + 30% loan); option to sell surplus power.
documents: Aadhaar; land docs; pump/site details; NOC if joint land.

name: PMFBY – Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana
benefits: Low‑premium crop insurance (Kharif 2%, Rabi 1.5%, Cash 5%); covers calamities & localised risks.
documents: Land records; crop sowing details; bank/KCC proof (as per insurer).

name: National Mission on Sustainable Agriculture (NMSA)
benefits: Support for soil health, water conservation, and organic farming.
documents: Aadhaar; soil test reports; land documents.

name: Rashtriya Krishi Vikas Yojana (RKVY)
benefits: State-specific development plan funding for agriculture & allied sectors.

name: Soil Health Card Scheme
benefits: Provides free soil health cards to farmers for balanced fertilizer use.

name: National Food Security Mission (NFSM)
benefits: Improved crop productivity of rice, wheat, pulses, coarse cereals, and commercial crops.

name: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY) – Pilot Extension
benefits: Crop insurance coverage for more crops and regions in Maharashtra.
documents: Aadhaar; crop sowing details; bank/KCC proof

name: Paramparagat Krishi Vikas Yojana
benefits: Promotion of organic farming through cluster approach.

name: Pradhan Mantri Krishi Sinchai Yojana (PMKSY)
benefits: Water use efficiency, irrigation infrastructure, and micro-irrigation support.

name: Sub-Mission on Agroforestry
benefits: Financial assistance for planting trees on farmland and farm bunds.

name: National Mission on Horticulture
benefits: Subsidy for horticulture crops, post-harvest management & marketing.

name: Market Intervention Scheme
benefits: Price support for perishables like fruits & vegetables during distress.

name: PM-PRANAM
benefits: Incentives for soil health & micronutrient use in Maharashtra.

name: National Agricultural Market (e-NAM)
benefits: Digital platform for selling crops at competitive rates across markets.

name: Chief Minister Krushi Sanjivani Yojana
benefits: Free soil testing and crop advisory for Maharashtra farmers.

name: Maharashtra Organic Farming Scheme
benefits: Subsidy for organic farming & certification support.

name: Water Resources Development Scheme
benefits: Support for irrigation, check dams, and farm ponds.

name: Maharashtra Crop Diversification Program
benefits: Support for growing high-value crops and horticulture crops.

name: Maharashtra Micro Irrigation Scheme
benefits: Subsidy for drip & sprinkler irrigation to conserve water.
